survey.title: Two-Number Addition Program Survey
survey.description: Collect feedback on the design, usability, and functionality of a program that adds two numbers.
survey.welcome_text: Welcome! We appreciate your input on our two-number addition program. Your responses are confidential and will help us improve the tool.
survey.end_text: Thank you for your valuable feedback!
